defaults.unknown: Column from this table. Add a table-specific definition in this file to replace this fallback tooltip.
defaults.gold_files: Number of PRIDE SDRF data files considered by the comparison.
defaults.assessed_files: Number of HAMLET SDRF data files considered by the comparison.
defaults.matched: Number of data files or entities paired between the HAMLET and PRIDE SDRFs.
defaults.missing_from_assessed: PRIDE data files or entities without a corresponding HAMLET record.
defaults.assessed_only: HAMLET data files or entities without a corresponding PRIDE record.
defaults.coverage: Proportion of PRIDE files represented by a matched HAMLET file.
defaults.metadata_type: Metadata entity type included in the comparison summary.
defaults.data_file: Raw or derived data file used to align the HAMLET and PRIDE SDRF records.
defaults.category: Canonical SDRF metadata category used by the conflict assessment.
defaults.assessed_value: Value recorded in HAMLET's stored SDRF.
defaults.gold_value: Value recorded in the PRIDE SDRF.
defaults.normalized_assessed_value: HAMLET value after the comparison normalizes case, whitespace, controlled-vocabulary forms, and comparable text.
defaults.normalized_gold_value: PRIDE value after the comparison normalizes case, whitespace, controlled-vocabulary forms, and comparable text.
defaults.status: Comparison outcome for this entity or value.
defaults.match_method: Method that established the match, such as exact normalized text, CV accession, or fuzzy text similarity.
defaults.similarity: Text-similarity score used when a fuzzy comparison was considered; 1 means identical normalized text.
defaults.assessed_entities: Number of distinct metadata entities in HAMLET's SDRF for this comparison unit.
defaults.gold_entities: Number of distinct metadata entities in the PRIDE SDRF for this comparison unit.
defaults.matched_entities: Number of metadata entities matched between HAMLET and PRIDE within the same canonical field.
defaults.assessed_only_entities: HAMLET metadata entities that did not match a PRIDE entity.
defaults.gold_only_entities: PRIDE metadata entities that did not match a HAMLET entity.
defaults.precision: Matched entities divided by HAMLET entities: M / (M + assessed-only).
defaults.recall: Matched entities divided by PRIDE entities: M / (M + gold-only).
defaults.f1: Harmonic mean of precision and recall: 2PR / (P + R).
defaults.macro_precision: Arithmetic mean of precision across contributing comparison units, weighting every unit equally.
defaults.macro_recall: Arithmetic mean of recall across contributing comparison units, weighting every unit equally.
defaults.macro_f1: Arithmetic mean of F1 across contributing comparison units, weighting every unit equally.
defaults.micro_precision: Precision calculated after pooling matched and HAMLET-only entity counts across the comparison unit.
defaults.micro_recall: Recall calculated after pooling matched and PRIDE-only entity counts across the comparison unit.
defaults.micro_f1: F1 calculated from the pooled micro precision and micro recall.
defaults.mean_precision: Arithmetic mean of precision values across the contributing comparison units.
defaults.mean_recall: Arithmetic mean of recall values across the contributing comparison units.
defaults.mean_f1: Arithmetic mean of F1 values across the contributing comparison units.
defaults.sdrf row: One-based row number in HAMLET's final SDRF.
defaults.source name: SDRF source-name identifier for the biological sample or material.
defaults.sdrf header: Exact SDRF column whose value is described by this confidence record.
defaults.agent confidence: Confidence assigned by the metadata agent to the selected value.
defaults.judge verdict: Final evaluator verdict for the selected annotation.
defaults.judge hallucination: Whether the evaluator judged the selected annotation unsupported by its evidence.
defaults.judge type mismatch: Whether the evaluator judged the selected annotation to have the wrong semantic type.
defaults.selected value: Value written to the final HAMLET SDRF.
defaults.selected source: Evidence source selected to supply the final SDRF value.
defaults.evidence: Supporting text or structured evidence for the selected value.
defaults.agent status: Relationship between metadata agents for the selected field, such as agreement or a single-agent value.
defaults.judge corrected value: Replacement value proposed by the final evaluator, when one was supplied.
defaults.resolution rule: Rule used to select or derive the final SDRF value.
defaults.assessment state: Whether the value was derived, inferred, or otherwise assessed during SDRF construction.
defaults.paper_id: Publication or dataset identifier evaluated by the judge.
defaults.source: Evidence source used by the evaluator, when recorded.
defaults.agent: HAMLET metadata agent that supplied the annotation.
defaults.annotation_type: Canonical metadata field evaluated by the judge.
defaults.extracted_value: Candidate value supplied to the judge.
defaults.all_values_for_field: All candidate values available for the same metadata field.
defaults.verdict: Overall judge confidence verdict for the candidate value.
defaults.type_mismatch: Whether the candidate value has an incompatible semantic type.
defaults.correct_type: Corrected semantic type suggested by the judge, when applicable.
defaults.value_correct: Whether the judge found the candidate value factually correct.
defaults.value_complete: Whether the judge found the candidate value sufficiently complete.
defaults.hallucination: Whether the judge found the candidate unsupported by the available evidence.
defaults.technical_origin: Whether the value originated from a technical source or technical inference.
defaults.inference: Whether the candidate relies on inference rather than explicit source evidence.
defaults.error_category: Judge-assigned category for a detected annotation issue.
defaults.issue_summary: Evaluator rationale, including type, source, truth, completeness, and corrected-value checks.
defaults.corrected_value: Replacement value suggested by the evaluator, when applicable.
defaults.mapped_field: SDRF or canonical field mapped from the pipeline field.
defaults.was_extracted: Whether the evaluator found an extracted value for the mapped field.
defaults.total_extracted: Total candidate annotations evaluated for this paper or dataset.
defaults.judge_n_correct: Count of candidate annotations judged correct.
defaults.judge_n_hallucinated: Count of candidate annotations judged hallucinated.
defaults.judge_n_mismatch: Count of candidate annotations with a type mismatch.
defaults.judge_n_wrong: Count of candidate annotations judged factually wrong.
defaults.judge_n_incomplete: Count of candidate annotations judged incomplete.
defaults.judge_n_corrected: Count of candidate annotations with a proposed correction.
defaults.judge_n_technical_not_in_text: Count of technical annotations not explicitly present in the paper text.
defaults.judge_n_inferred: Count of annotations based on inference.
defaults.judge_accuracy: Proportion of evaluated annotations judged correct by the reported accuracy rule.
defaults.judge_accuracy_adjusted: Accuracy after the evaluator's adjusted treatment of eligible annotations.
defaults.judge_accuracy_with_inference: Accuracy calculated with inferred annotations included.
defaults.definition: Meaning of the SDRF metadata category.
defaults.requirement: Requirement level assigned by the SDRF term catalog.
defaults.type: SDRF namespace used for the metadata category.
defaults.ontology_accession: Primary ontology accession associated with the SDRF term.
defaults.pxds: Number of final HAMLET SDRFs in which this header is present.

sdrf_headers.source name: Unique identifier for the biological sample material.
sdrf_headers.assay name: Unique identifier for the assay or mass-spectrometry run within the study.
sdrf_headers.technology type: Technology used for the assay; HAMLET SDRFs describe proteomic profiling by mass spectrometry.
sdrf_headers.characteristics[organism]: Species of the analyzed proteomics sample material.
sdrf_headers.characteristics[organism part]: Anatomical part, tissue, or organelle from which the analyzed material originated.
sdrf_headers.characteristics[cell type]: Biological cell type of the analyzed material, distinct from a cell-line name.
sdrf_headers.characteristics[cell line]: Cell line analyzed by proteomics, when the cell line itself is the sample material.
sdrf_headers.characteristics[cellosaurus accession]: Cellosaurus accession that identifies the analyzed cell line.
sdrf_headers.characteristics[disease]: Disease or health state of the analyzed sample material.
sdrf_headers.characteristics[age]: Age or age range of the donor or source organism at sample collection.
sdrf_headers.characteristics[sex]: Biological sex of the donor or source organism.
sdrf_headers.characteristics[individual]: Identifier for the biological donor individual.
sdrf_headers.characteristics[biological replicate]: Identifier for a distinct biological sample unit in the experiment.
sdrf_headers.characteristics[treatment]: Treatment or perturbation applied to the analyzed sample material.
sdrf_headers.characteristics[enrichment process]: Whether and how the analyzed material was enriched before proteomics analysis.
sdrf_headers.comment[proteomics data acquisition meth: Mass-spectrometry acquisition strategy used for the submitted proteomics run, such as DDA or DIA.
sdrf_headers.comment[label]: Labeling or quantification strategy used for the analyzed sample, such as label-free, TMT, or SILAC.
sdrf_headers.comment[instrument]: Mass spectrometer instrument model used for the analyzed proteomics run.
sdrf_headers.comment[cleavage agent details]: Protease or chemical used to digest proteins for the proteomics sample preparation.
sdrf_headers.comment[fraction identifier]: Identifier or number for the fraction analyzed in this run.
sdrf_headers.comment[technical replicate]: Identifier for a repeated measurement of the same proteomics sample material.
sdrf_headers.comment[dissociation method]: Fragmentation method used for tandem mass spectrometry, such as CID, HCD, or ETD.
sdrf_headers.comment[modification parameters]: Fixed or variable protein and peptide modifications used in database searching or labeling.
sdrf_headers.comment[precursor mass tolerance]: Permitted precursor-ion mass error used for database searching.
sdrf_headers.comment[fragment mass tolerance]: Permitted fragment-ion mass error used for database searching.
sdrf_headers.comment[reduction reagent]: Chemical used to reduce disulfide bonds during sample preparation.
sdrf_headers.comment[alkylation reagent]: Chemical used to alkylate cysteines during sample preparation.
sdrf_headers.comment[ms2 mass analyzer]: Mass analyzer used to acquire MS2 spectra.
sdrf_headers.comment[ms1 scan range]: Lower and upper m/z limits acquired for MS1 scans.
sdrf_headers.comment[collision energy]: Collision energy applied during fragmentation for tandem mass spectrometry.
sdrf_headers.comment[data file]: Name of the raw data file associated with the assay.
sdrf_headers.comment[sdrf version]: Version of the SDRF structure written by HAMLET.
sdrf_headers.comment[sdrf annotation tool]: Tool and release that generated the SDRF annotation.
sdrf_headers.factor value[disease]: Disease state when disease is an experimental variable used to define sample groups.
sdrf_headers.factor value[experimental design]: Experimental variable or study-group label used to define the sample design.

entity_matches.tsv.status: Whether the entity is shared, only in HAMLET, only in PRIDE, or otherwise unmatched.

field_summary.tsv.macro_precision: Mean precision across non-empty file-level comparisons for this field, with each contributing comparison given equal weight.
field_summary.tsv.macro_recall: Mean recall across non-empty file-level comparisons for this field, with each contributing comparison given equal weight.
field_summary.tsv.macro_f1: Mean F1 across non-empty file-level comparisons for this field, with each contributing comparison given equal weight.

sample_category_metrics.tsv.precision: For this PXD file and category, matched entities / HAMLET entities.
sample_category_metrics.tsv.recall: For this PXD file and category, matched entities / PRIDE entities.
sample_category_metrics.tsv.f1: For this PXD file and category, the harmonic mean of precision and recall.

sample_field_metrics.tsv.micro_precision: For this PXD file, category, and field, matched entities / HAMLET entities after pooling values in that field.
sample_field_metrics.tsv.micro_recall: For this PXD file, category, and field, matched entities / PRIDE entities after pooling values in that field.
sample_field_metrics.tsv.micro_f1: For this PXD file, category, and field, the harmonic mean of micro precision and micro recall.
